function t6.File.HasFS()

function t6.File.EnsureFolders()

        return false
    end

    return pcall(function()
        if not isfolder(t6.Config.Root) then
            makefolder(t6.Config.Root)
        end

        if not isfolder(t6.Config.Cache) then
            makefolder(t6.Config.Cache)
        end
    end)
end
function t6.File.Read(p1)
    if type(p1) ~= "string" or p1 == "" or not t6.File.HasFS() or not isfile(p1) then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(readfile, p1)

    return ok and (type(result) == "string" and result) or nil
end
function t6.File.Write(p2, p3)

        return false
    end

    t6.File.EnsureFolders()

end

end

function t6.Net.Post(p7, p8, p9)
    if type(p7) ~= "string" or p7 == "" then
        return false, 0, "", "Invalid URL"
    end

    local t8 = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
	}

    if type(p9) == "string" and p9 ~= "" then
        t8.Authorization = "Bearer " .. p9
    end

    local s1 = ""

    if type(p8) == "table" then
        local ok, result = pcall(t6.Services.HttpService.JSONEncode, t6.Services.HttpService, p8)

        if not ok then
            return false, 0, "", "Failed to encode request"
        end

        s1 = result
    end

    local v84 = t6.Net.RequestFunction()
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        if type(v84) == "function" then
            return v84({
				Url = p7,
				Method = "POST",
				Headers = t8,
				Body = s1
			})
        end

        return t6.Services.HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = p7,
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = t8,
			Body = s1
		})
    end)

    if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
        return false, 0, "", (tostring(result or "Request failed"))
    end

    local v87 = tonumber(result.StatusCode or (result.Status or result.status_code)) or 0
    local v88 = result.Body or (result.body or "")
    local v89 = type(v88) == "string" and v88 or tostring(v88 or "")

    if v87 == 0 and v89 ~= "" then
        v87 = 200
    end

    return true, v87, v89, nil
end

end

end

function t6.Auth.Apply(p16, p17)

        t6.State.UiUrl = v104

    t6.State.ExpiresAt = p16.key_expires_at or (p16.expires_at or t6.State.ExpiresAt)
    t6.State.Premium = p16.pro == true or p16.premium == true

    if p17 == "login" then
        local v105 = p16.script_token or p16.session_token

        t6.State.ScriptToken = type(v105) == "string" and (v105 ~= "" and v105) or nil

function t6.Auth.ResponseType(p18, p19)

        if p18.pro == true or p18.premium == true then
            return "pro"
        end

        local v108 = p18.key_type or (p18.type or p18.method)

        if type(v108) == "string" and v108 ~= "" then
            return v108
        end
    end

    local str = tostring(p19 or "auto")

    return str ~= "" and (str ~= "auto" and str) or "lootlabs"
end
function t6.Auth.CheckOnce(p20, p21, p22)
    local v113, v114, v115, v116 = t6.Net.Post(t6.Config.AuthUrl, t6.Auth.Payload(p20, p21, p22))

    if not v113 then
        return false, v116 or "Request failed", true, nil
    end

    local v117 = t6.Net.Decode(v115)

    if type(v117) ~= "table" then
        return false, "Invalid server response", t6.Net.IsTemporary(v114), nil
    end

    t6.Auth.Apply(v117, p20)

    if t6.Net.IsTemporary(v114) then
        return false, v117.msg or (v117.message or "Server unavailable"), true, nil
    end

    if v117.success == true then
        if p20 == "login" and not t6.State.ScriptToken then
            return false, "Missing script token", true, nil
        end

        t6.State.Authenticated = true

        return true, nil, false, v117
    end

    return false, tostring(v117.msg or (v117.message or (v117.code or "Authentication failed"))), false, v117
end
function t6.Auth.Check(p23, p24, p25)
    local s2 = "Request failed"

    for i = 1, t6.Config.AuthRetries do
        local v123, v124, v125, v126 = t6.Auth.CheckOnce(p23, p24, p25)

        if v123 then
            return true, nil, v126
        end

        s2 = v124 or s2

        if not v125 then
            return false, s2, v126
        end

        if i < t6.Config.AuthRetries then
            task.wait(t6.Config.RetryDelay * i)
        end
    end

    return false, s2, nil
end
function t6.Auth.Login(p26, p27, p28)
    local v130 = t6.Auth.CleanKey(p26)
    local str = tostring(p27 or "auto")
    local v132, v133, v134 = t6.Auth.Check("login", v130, str)

    if not v132 then
        t6.State.Authenticated = false

        return false, v133, v134
    end

    t6.State.Key = v130
    t6.State.KeyType = t6.Auth.ResponseType(v134, str)

    if p28 then
        t6.File.SaveAuth(t6.State.KeyType, t6.State.Key)
    end

    return true, nil, v134
end
function t6.Auth.StartHeartbeat()
    if t6.State.HeartbeatRunning or not t6.State.Authenticated then
        return
    end

    t6.State.HeartbeatRunning = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while t6.State.HeartbeatRunning and t6.State.Authenticated do
            task.wait(t6.Config.Heartbeat)

            if not t6.State.HeartbeatRunning or not t6.State.Authenticated then
                return
            end

            local Premium = t6.State.Premium
            local v212, v213, v214 = t6.Auth.Check("heartbeat", t6.State.Key, t6.State.KeyType)

            if not v212 then
                if type(v214) ~= "table" then
                    continue
                end

                t6.Security.Revoke(v213 or "Access revoked")

                return
            end

            t6.UI.UpdateExpiryLabel()

            if Premium and not t6.State.Premium then
                t6.Security.RunResets("Premium access ended")
            end
        end
    end)
end
function t6.UI.Notify(p29, p30)

        return

    if t6.State.Library and type(t6.State.Library.Notify) == "function" then

            t6.State.Library:Notify(str, tonumber(p30) or 3)
        end)

        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        t6.Services.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
			Title = "Exotic Hub",
			Text = str,
			Duration = tonumber(p30) or 3
		})
    end)
end

    t6.UI.Notify("Clipboard is not supported", 3)

end
function t6.UI.RunSource(p32)
    if type(p32) ~= "string" or (#p32 < 100 or type(loadstring) ~= "function") then
        warn("[EXO UI] Invalid source or loadstring unavailable")

        return nil
    end

    local v140, v141 = loadstring(p32)

    if type(v140) ~= "function" then
        warn("[EXO UI] Compile failed: " .. tostring(v141))

        return nil
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(v140)

    if not ok then
        warn("[EXO UI] Startup failed: " .. tostring(result))

        return nil
    end

    return result
end
function t6.UI.Load()
    if t6.State.Headless then
        return true
    end

    local str = tostring(t6.State.UiVersion or "")
    local v145 = t6.State.UiUrl ~= "" and t6.State.UiUrl or t6.Config.UiUrl

    if str == "" then
        return false, "Server did not return UI version"
    end

    t6.File.EnsureFolders()

    if str == t6.File.Read(t6.Config.UiVersionFile) then
        local v146 = t6.UI.RunSource(t6.File.Read(t6.Config.UiFile))

        if v146 then
            t6.State.Library = v146
            t6.Public.Library = v146

            return true
        end
    end

    local s3 = "?"

    if v145:find("?", 1, true) then
        s3 = "&"
    end

    local v148 = v145 .. s3 .. "version=" .. str
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(v148, true)
    end)

    if not ok then
        warn("[EXO UI] Download failed: " .. tostring(result))
    end

    local v151 = ok and t6.UI.RunSource(result) or nil

    if not v151 then
        return false, "Failed to load UI"
    end

    t6.File.Write(t6.Config.UiFile, result)
    t6.File.Write(t6.Config.UiVersionFile, str)
    t6.State.Library = v151
    t6.Public.Library = v151

    return true
end
function t6.UI.CreateWindow()
    if t6.State.Headless or t6.State.Window then
        return true
    end

    local Library = t6.State.Library

    if not Library or type(Library.CreateWindow) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return Library:CreateWindow({
			Title = not t6.State.Premium and "Exotic Hub" or "<font color='#FFFFFF'>Exotic Hub</font> <font color='#FF00C8'>PRO</font>",
			Footer = "exotichub.app/join",
			ToggleKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
			Center = true,
			ShowCustomCursor = false,
			AutoShow = t6.State.AutoShow
		})
    end)

    if not ok or not result then
        return false
    end

    t6.State.Window = result
    t6.Public.Window = result

    return true
end
function t6.UI.ExpiryText()
    local num = tonumber(t6.State.ExpiresAt)

    if not num then
        return "Key expiry is not available"
    end

    if num > 100000000000 then
        num = math.floor(num / 1000)
    end

    local v156 = math.floor(num - os.time())

    if v156 <= 0 then
        return "Key expired"
    end

    local v157 = math.floor(v156 / 86400)
    local v158 = math.floor(v156 % 86400 / 3600)
    local v159 = math.floor(v156 % 3600 / 60)
    local t9 = {}

    if v157 > 0 then
        table.insert(t9, v157 .. (v157 ~= 1 and " days" or " day"))
    end

    if v158 > 0 then
        table.insert(t9, v158 .. (v158 ~= 1 and " hours" or " hour"))
    end

    if v159 > 0 then
        table.insert(t9, v159 .. " min")
    end

    if #t9 == 0 then
        table.insert(t9, v156 .. " sec")
    end

    return "Key expires in " .. table.concat(t9, " ")
end
function t6.UI.UpdateExpiryLabel()
    local AccountExpiryLabel = t6.State.AccountExpiryLabel

    if AccountExpiryLabel and type(AccountExpiryLabel.SetText) == "function" then
        AccountExpiryLabel:SetText(t6.UI.ExpiryText())
    end
end
function t6.UI.AddAccount()
    if t6.State.Headless or (t6.State.AccountAdded or not t6.State.Window) then
        return
    end

    local LoginTab = t6.State.LoginTab

    if LoginTab then
        if LoginTab.TabLabel then
            LoginTab.TabLabel.Text = "Account"
        end

        if t6.State.LoginGroup and t6.State.LoginGroup.BoxHolder then
            t6.State.LoginGroup.BoxHolder.Visible = false
        end
    else
        LoginTab = t6.State.Window:AddTab({
			Name = "Account",
			Description = "Exotic Hub account",
			Icon = "circle-user-round"
		})
    end

    if not LoginTab then
        return
    end

    local v163 = LoginTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Account", "circle-user-round", false)
    local v164 = LoginTab:AddRightGroupbox("Logout", "circle-user-round")

    if v164 then
        v164:AddButton({
			Text = "<font color='#FF5555'>Logout</font>",
			Func = function()
            local Library = t6.State.Library

            if not Library or type(Library.Confirm) ~= "function" then
                return
            end

            Library:Confirm({
					Title = "Logout?",
					Description = "This will clear your saved key and remove you from the game.",
					Risky = true,
					Callback = function(p33)
                if p33 then
                    t6.Security.Logout()
                end
            end
				})
        end
		})
    end

    if v163 then
        t6.State.AccountExpiryLabel = v163:AddLabel({
			Text = t6.UI.ExpiryText(),
			DoesWrap = true
		})
        v163:AddButton({
			Text = "Join Discord",
			Func = function()
            t6.UI.Copy(t6.Config.DiscordUrl)
        end
		})
    end

    t6.State.AccountAdded = true
end
function t6.UI.SetStatus(p34)
    if t6.State.LoginStatus and type(t6.State.LoginStatus.SetText) == "function" then
        t6.State.LoginStatus:SetText((tostring(p34 or "")))
    end
end
function t6.UI.ShowLogin(p35)
    if t6.State.Headless or not t6.State.Window then
        return false
    end

    local v167 = t6.State.Window:AddTab({
		Name = "Key System",
		Description = "Enter your Exotic Hub key",
		Icon = "key-round"
	})
    local v168 = v167 and v167:AddLeftGroupbox("Key Entry", "key-round", false) or nil

    if not v168 then
        return false
    end

    t6.State.LoginTab = v167
    t6.State.LoginGroup = v168
    v168:AddInput("exo_loader_key_input", {
		Text = "Access Key",
		Default = t6.State.Key,
		Numeric = false,
		AllowEmpty = true,
		Finished = false,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Tooltip = "Enter your Exotic Hub key.",
		Placeholder = "Enter key"
	})
    t6.State.LoginStatus = v168:AddLabel({
		Text = tostring(p35 or "Enter your key to continue."),
		DoesWrap = true
	})
    v168:AddButton({
		Text = "Login",
		Func = function()
        if t6.State.LoginBusy then
            return
        end

        t6.State.LoginBusy = true
        t6.UI.SetStatus("Checking key...")
        task.spawn(function()
            local v217 = t6.State.Library and t6.State.Library.Options
            local v218 = v217 and v217.exo_loader_key_input
            local v219, v220 = t6.Auth.Login(v218 and v218.Value or "", "auto", true)

            if not v219 then
                t6.UI.SetStatus("❌ " .. tostring(v220 or "Login failed"))
                t6.State.LoginBusy = false

                return
            end

            t6.UI.SetStatus("✅ Key accepted. Loading script...")

            local v221, v222 = t6.Script.Load()

            if not v221 then
                t6.UI.SetStatus("❌ " .. tostring(v222 or "Script failed to load"))
                t6.State.LoginBusy = false

                return
            end

            t6.UI.AddAccount()
            t6.Auth.StartHeartbeat()
            t6.State.LoginBusy = false
        end)
    end
	})
    v168:AddButton({
		Text = "Get Free Key",
		Func = function()
        t6.UI.Copy(t6.Config.FreeKeyUrl)
    end
	})
    v168:AddButton({
		Text = "Join Discord",
		Func = function()
        t6.UI.Copy(t6.Config.DiscordUrl)
    end
	})

    return true
end
function t6.Script.Fetch(p36)
    if type(p36) ~= "string" or p36 == "" then
        return false, "Missing script token", true
    end

    local v170, v171, v172, v173 = t6.Net.Post(t6.Config.ScriptUrl, nil, p36)

    if not v170 then
        return false, v173 or "Script request failed", true
    end

    if v171 == 401 or v171 == 403 or v171 == 409 or v171 == 410 then
        local v174 = t6.Net.Decode(v172)

        return false, v174 and (v174.msg or (v174.message or v174.code)) or "Script token rejected", true
    end

    if t6.Net.IsTemporary(v171) then
        return false, "Script server unavailable", true
    end

    if v171 < 200 or v171 >= 300 then
        local v175 = t6.Net.Decode(v172)

        return false, v175 and (v175.msg or (v175.message or v175.code)) or "Script request rejected", false
    end

    local v176 = v172:match("^%s*{") and t6.Net.Decode(v172) or nil

    if v176 and v176.success == false then
        return false, v176.msg or (v176.message or (v176.code or "Script request failed")), true
    end

    if type(v172) ~= "string" or #v172 < 50 then
        return false, "Script response was empty", true
    end

    local v177, v178 = loadstring(v172)

    if type(v177) ~= "function" then
        return false, "Script compile failed: " .. tostring(v178), true
    end

    return true, v177, false
end
function t6.Script.FreshToken()
    return t6.Auth.Login(t6.State.Key, t6.State.KeyType, false)
end
function t6.Script.Load()
    if t6.State.ScriptLoaded then
        return true
    end

    local s4 = "Failed to download script"

    for i = 1, t6.Config.ScriptRetries do
        local ScriptToken = t6.State.ScriptToken

        t6.State.ScriptToken = nil

        if type(ScriptToken) ~= "string" or ScriptToken == "" then
            local v182, v183 = t6.Script.FreshToken()

            if not v182 then
                return false, v183 or s4
            end

            ScriptToken = t6.State.ScriptToken
            t6.State.ScriptToken = nil
        end

        local v184, v185, v186 = t6.Script.Fetch(ScriptToken)

        if v184 then
            if t6.State.Premium then
                t6.File.Write(t6.Config.LegacyProFile, "true")
                t6.Env.exoprov = true
                _G.exoprov = true
            end

            local ok, result = pcall(v185, t6.Public)

            if not ok then
                return false, "Script startup failed: " .. tostring(result)
            end

            t6.State.ScriptLoaded = true

            return true
        end

        s4 = v185 or s4

        if not v186 then
            return false, s4
        end

        if i < t6.Config.ScriptRetries then
            task.wait(t6.Config.RetryDelay * i)

            local v189, v190 = t6.Script.FreshToken()

            if v189 then
                continue
            end

            return false, v190 or s4
        end
    end

    return false, s4
end
function t6.Security.RunResets(p37)
    for _, v in ipairs(t6.State.Resets) do
        pcall(v, (tostring(p37 or "Access ended")))
    end
end
function t6.Security.Revoke(p38)
    if t6.State.Revoked then
        return
    end

    t6.State.Revoked = true
    t6.State.Authenticated = false
    t6.State.Premium = false
    t6.State.HeartbeatRunning = false
    t6.Security.RunResets(p38)
    t6.File.ClearAuth()
    t6.UI.Notify(tostring(p38 or "Access revoked") .. ". Rejoin to continue.", 5)
    task.delay(2, function()
        if t6.Services.LocalPlayer then
            t6.Services.LocalPlayer:Kick((tostring(p38 or "Access revoked")))
        end
    end)
end
function t6.Security.Logout()
    t6.State.Authenticated = false
    t6.State.Premium = false
    t6.State.HeartbeatRunning = false
    t6.Security.RunResets("Logged out")
    t6.File.ClearAuth()
    t6.File.Delete(t6.Config.LegacyProFile)
    t6.Env.__EXO_SHARED = nil
    t6.UI.Notify("Logged out. Rejoin to use Exotic Hub again.", 5)
    task.delay(2, function()
        if t6.Services.LocalPlayer then
            t6.Services.LocalPlayer:Kick("Logged out. Rejoin to continue.")
        end
    end)
end
function t6.Public.IsPremium()
    return t6.State.Authenticated and t6.State.Premium
end
function t6.Public.IsHeadless()
    return t6.State.Headless
end
function t6.Public.RegisterReset(p39)
    if type(p39) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end

    table.insert(t6.State.Resets, p39)

    return true
end
t6.Public.Library = nil
t6.Public.Window = nil
function t6.Run()
    if type(t6.Env.__EXO_SHARED) == "table" then
        warn("[EXO] Loader is already running")

        return
    end

    local v196 = tostring(t6.Env.mode or (_G.mode or "")):lower()
    local v197 = t6.Env.exo_key or _G.exo_key

    t6.State.Headless = v196 == "noui"
    t6.State.DeviceId = t6.Device.Get()
    t6.State.Platform = t6.Device.GetPlatform()
    t6.Env.exo_key = nil
    t6.Env.mode = nil
    _G.exo_key = nil
    _G.mode = nil

    local exo_autoshow = t6.Env.exo_autoshow

    t6.Env.exo_autoshow = nil
    _G.exo_autoshow = nil
    t6.State.AutoShow = exo_autoshow ~= false

    local v199, v200 = t6.File.LoadAuth()

    if type(v197) == "string" and t6.Auth.CleanKey(v197) ~= "" then
        t6.State.Key = t6.Auth.CleanKey(v197)
        t6.State.KeyType = "auto"
        t6.State.FromGlobalKey = true
    elseif v200 then
        t6.State.Key = t6.Auth.CleanKey(v200)
        t6.State.KeyType = tostring(v199 or "auto")
    end

    local v201, v202, v203 = t6.Auth.Login(t6.State.Key, t6.State.KeyType, not t6.State.FromGlobalKey and t6.State.Key ~= "")

    if t6.State.Headless then
        if not v201 then
            local str = tostring(v202 or "Authentication failed")

            warn("[EXO] " .. str)

            if type(v203) == "table" and t6.Services.LocalPlayer then
                t6.Services.LocalPlayer:Kick("Exotic Hub: " .. str)
            end

            return
        end

        t6.Env.__EXO_SHARED = t6.Public

        local v205, v206 = t6.Script.Load()

        if not v205 then
            warn("[EXO] " .. tostring(v206))

            return
        end

        t6.Auth.StartHeartbeat()

        return
    end

    local v207, v208 = t6.UI.Load()

    if not v207 then
        warn("[EXO] " .. tostring(v208))

        return
    end

    if not t6.UI.CreateWindow() then
        warn("[EXO] Failed to create UI window")

        return
    end

    t6.Env.__EXO_SHARED = t6.Public

    if not v201 then
        t6.UI.ShowLogin(v202)

        return
    end

    t6.UI.AddAccount()

    local v209, v210 = t6.Script.Load()

    if not v209 then
        t6.UI.Notify(tostring(v210), 6)
        warn("[EXO] " .. tostring(v210))

        return
    end

    t6.Auth.StartHeartbeat()
end
t6.Run()
